posts.title: Shigekazu Ukai
posts.content:
鵜飼 重和
Managing Director / Consultant
Singapore

Mr. Ukai is the Managing Director of AZMA & Associates Singapore and a specialist in the Asset Management and Alternative Investment Management market. He is responsible for all front, middle and back office positions in the Asia Pacific and Tokyo regions. He has been in the Executive Search industry for 15 years which focusses on Asset Management.

Prior to AZMA & Associates, he was a Managing Director, Head of APAC Financial Service Practice of a Singapore-based Search Firm. Before that he was a Consultant in the Asset Management Division of another Global Search Firm. His first Executive Search career was at Heidrick & Struggles Tokyo, where he worked as an Executive Recruiter in all aspects of finance, including Asset Management, Investment Banking, Global Markets (Fixed income and Equities), Private Equity and Real Estate.

Mr. Ukai received his Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management from Central Queensland University (Australia)

pages.title: Search Process
pages.content:
1. Pre-search activities

  • Detailed discussion with a hiring manager and/or HR to have a clear understanding of the position
  • Set a realistic budget based on current market conditions
  • Develop a job description to ensure right alignment of the hiring requirement

2. Search activities

  • Create Longlist and interview all the relevant candidates and assess them based on eligibility and suitability
  • Shortlist 3-5 best-fit candidates for the position and present them to a hiring manager and/or HR 

3. Weekly update

  • A weekly report on the search progress will be submitted to a hiring manager and/or HR. Information provided include search challenges, market feedback, and candidates interviewed

4. Client interview

  • Make all interview arrangements
  • Review and take feedback candidates

5. Reference checks

  • We will conduct 2-3 reference checks with the candidates’ former superiors to assess further information like job performance, work ethic, attitude and other criteria that are important when making a hiring decision

6. Final negotiations

  • Play an active role in salary negotiations, including managing the candidate’s expectations from first contact according to the market situation and the client’s budge
  • Manage a candidate to handle counter-offer by a current employer
  • Ensure the candidate resigns and liaise with HR department for success onboarding
  • Follow up with a candidate until the join date and after joining the company

pages.title: Vision &  Mission
pages.content:
Vision

  • We provide our clients with the information and perspectives they need to make decisions, and we work constantly as their partner, to support long-term hiring and career success.
  • We brief our clients, frankly and fairly, on the risks and other downsides of hiring and job changes, not just on the potential upsides.
  • In introducing appropriate personnel to our clients, and appropriate positions to business professionals, we carry on rigorous internal vetting in order to make both parties’ time more worthwhile. As a professional search firm, we see making time for both sides as one of our roles, and as an element in our service content.
  • To provide our clients and business professionals with stable services at all times, we endeavor to build an environment in which our own employees too can maintain stable employment wherever possible.

Mission

  • The foundation of this company sprang from our representative’s experience in delivering expert consulting services, mainly on the Financial Service recruiter of professional search firms. That experience led to our desire to provide clients and business professionals with proposals that reflect long-term thinking and a higher level of focus on specialized fields.
  • Our greatest objective is to arrive at the best matching between personnel and companies. To that end, we deeply understand the personnel needs that match our clients’ management issues, and the positions that candidate business professionals aspire to, while valuing the confidentiality of both sides. On that basis, and covering the entire market, we are able to approach the ideal personnel and companies.
  • Our expert knowledge and advice is limited to specialized fields, so we are unwavering in our commitment to the success of clients and business professionals.

Representative Director Shigeyuki Ukai
